item.title: Top counterterrorism official resigns in protest of US war against Iran
Iranian Americans in Los Angeles react with mixed emotions as Iran conflict escalates
item.summary: Iranian Americans in Los Angeles celebrated the news of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's death, but their joy is also mixed with fear for loved ones still in Iran.

item.title: Top Iranian official, commander killed in strike, Israel defense minister says
item.summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Ali Larijani and Basij Commander Gholamreza Soleimani have been "eliminated," the Israel Defense Forces said.

item.title: Ex-Biden official faces backlash over thinly veiled warning to companies when Dems are back in charge
item.summary: Sen. Kennedy said last week he was concerned about comments made by Susan Rice telling companies they would be held accountable for aligning themselves with Trump.

item.title: Oil, gas prices jump as Trump flirts with striking Iranian oil infrastructure
item.summary: President Donald Trump targets Iran's Kharg Island oil hub, which handles 90% of Iranian crude exports to China and India, raising fears of broader Persian Gulf supply disruptions.

item.title: DHS hits back at Illinois county clerk who told ICE to stay away from primary polling places
item.summary: DHS rebukes Illinois clerk who called ICE agents "thugs" and warned them away from polling places during elections, sparking immigration enforcement debate.

item.title: WATCH: Wall-climbing robot swarms crawl US Navy warships as China’s fleet surges
item.summary: Wall-climbing robots are set to transform U.S. Navy ship maintenance in a $71 million program designed to slash repair delays and boost fleet readiness.

item.title: Republican senators blast Democrats for 'fear-mongering' over election security SAVE Act
item.summary: Republican senators accuse Democrats of fear-mongering over SAVE Act as Senate prepares vote on election safeguards that could affect voter roll removals.

item.title: Kid Rock fires back at Conan O’Brien’s Oscars jab, calling it 'not a very good’ joke
item.summary: Kid Rock responded to Conan O'Brien's Academy Awards joke about hosting an alternative Oscars, calling it "not a very good" joke while promoting his "Freedom 250" tour.

item.title: A basic monthly bill Americans can’t dodge is becoming a midterm flashpoint
item.summary: Rising electricity bills become key midterm election issue as voters face monthly costs they can't avoid, giving both parties new campaign ammunition.
